title: Coca-Cola announces Braun as CEO, Quincey as Executive Chairman
body: On December 10, 2025, Coca-Cola announced Henrique Braun would become CEO effective March 31, 2026, with James Quincey transitioning to Executive Chairman.

context.text: Coca-Cola  ( KO )  Q4 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
why: Coca-Cola's top leadership changed as its new CEO took charge, shifting strategic direction.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola appeals $2.6 billion transfer pricing tax ruling
body: Coca-Cola filed a notice of appeal on Oct. 22, 2024, challenging a U.S. Tax Court decision that imposed about $2.6 billion in transfer pricing tax deficiencies plus interest for 2007-2009.

context.text: Coca-Cola Weighs Tax Appeal, Cost Pressures And Mr. Pibb Expansion
why: A multi-billion dollar US Tax Court judgment with major financial implications is under appeal, creating material legal overhang.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola announces $6B Mexico investment
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced a $6 billion investment in Mexico following a meeting between global CEO Henrique Braun and President Claudia Sheinbaum.

context.text: Coca-Cola Plans Major US$6 billion Expansion in Mexico
why: A $6 billion Mexico expansion materially increases Coca-Cola's production and distribution footprint and capital commitments.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola R17.6B South Africa Investment to 2030
body: Coca-Cola and its bottlers announced a planned R17.6 billion ($1.05 billion) investment in South Africa through 2030 to expand production, distribution and innovation.

context.text: Coca-Cola plans to invest $1 billion in South Africa through 2030
why: Committed $1.05 billion with bottlers to expand South African production and distribution through 2030, materially increasing regional capacity.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola names new Global Chief People Officer
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on April 14, 2026 that Tapaswee Chandele will succeed Lisa Chang as global chief people officer on May 1, 2026 after Chang's seven-year tenure.

context.text: Coca-Cola's Lisa Chang to Step Down After Seven Years
why: Global Chief People Officer Lisa Chang stepped down, triggering a leadership transition effective May 1, 2026.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola becomes Marriott global beverage partner
body: Marriott International and The Coca-Cola Company announced on July 1, 2026 a global beverage agreement making Coca-Cola the global beverage partner across Marriott's portfolio, replacing Pepsi.

context.text: Coca-Cola replaces Pepsi as beverage provider for hotel chain Marriott International
why: Secured exclusive global beverage rights at Marriott's 9,700 properties, displacing Pepsi and expanding KO's distribution footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola reports Q1 2026 results, updates guidance
body: The Coca-Cola Company reported Q1 2026 net revenues grew 12% to $12.5 billion and updated full-year guidance, including raised comparable EPS growth of 8% to 9%.

context.text: Coca-Cola Is So Good at Marketing, Everyone Forgot to Notice
why: Coca-Cola raised full-year guidance after strong Q1 results, signaling improved earnings outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola unveils next-gen beverage dispensing
body: Coca-Cola announced Freestyle Equinox, modular systems and Freestyle Mini on May 12, 2026.

context.text: Coca-Cola plans to make soda fountains obsolete
why: Coca-Cola launched a next-gen Freestyle dispensing platform that cuts development time and modernizes its vending architecture.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola appeals IRS transfer pricing ruling to 11th Circuit
body: Coca-Cola appealed to the Eleventh Circuit (No. 24-13470) a Tax Court ruling that could impose up to $14 billion in additional tax beyond the $6 billion already paid.

context.text: Coca-Cola, IRS Face Off in Tax Appeal With Huge Stakes for Both
why: An adverse ruling in the expanded IRS transfer pricing appeal could expose Coca-Cola to up to $14 billion in additional tax liability.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola explores 2027 IPO of HCCH in India
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on June 1, 2026 it is exploring a potential 2027 public listing in India of Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Pvt. Ltd. and sale of part of its 60% stake.

context.text: Coca-Cola explores IPO of Indian bottling arm HCCH in 2027
why: A potential 2027 IPO of its largest Indian bottling unit advances Coca-Cola's asset-light strategy and could unlock significant capital.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola North America President steps down
body: Jennifer Mann will step down as EVP and President of the North America Operating Unit effective Aug. 1, 2026, with CFO John Murphy assuming the role on an interim basis.

context.text: Top Coca-Cola leader in its largest market to depart role
why: The departure of the North America President triggers a leadership change with the CFO taking interim control of a key region.
date evidence (day)

title: Fairlife ransomware suspends US production
body: Coca-Cola's Fairlife subsidiary identified a ransomware event on July 16, 2026 that temporarily suspended its U.S. production operations.

context.text: Coca-Cola says Fairlife ransomware attack halts US dairy production
why: A ransomware attack halting all U.S. Fairlife dairy production disrupted a $3B revenue brand.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola Q2 2026 results and raised guidance
body: The Coca-Cola Company reported Q2 2026 net revenues of $13.4 billion with comparable revenue about $13.37 billion beating estimates and raised its 2026 organic revenue and EPS growth forecasts amid a World Cup sales boost.

context.text: Coca-Cola hails World Cup hydration breaks as it lifts annual forecasts
why: Strong Q2 results and raised full-year guidance signal improved earnings outlook for investors.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola and Fairlife hit with data breach class action
body: Coca-Cola and Fairlife were named as defendants in a proposed federal class action filed August 3, 2026 over a ransomware attack that exposed employee names and Social Security numbers.

context.text: Hackers hit Coca-Cola and Chick-fil-A. Now come the data breach lawsuits.
why: The ransomware-related class action exposes Coca-Cola to legal liability and reputational harm from the July Fairlife breach.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola settles GVH probe over PET claims
body: Coca-Cola agreed to launch a recycling education campaign and stop using '100%-ban újrahasznosítható' for Naturaqua to settle the GVH's PET bottle green-claim probe.

context.text: Coca-Cola Group Pledges Recycling Campaign Following Hungarian Competition Authority Review
why: Settling the Hungarian probe forces Coca-Cola to change environmental marketing and run a recycling campaign, addressing regulatory risk in the EU.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola acquires remaining stake in BodyArmor
body: The Coca-Cola Company acquired full ownership of BodyArmor, paying $5.6 billion in cash for the remaining 85% stake.

context.text: Coca-Cola's $5.6B BodyArmor deal turned Kobe Bryant's $6M bet into $400M
why: Closing a $5.6B BodyArmor acquisition materially expands Coca-Cola's sports-drink portfolio and alters its competitive position.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola $10B US infrastructure plan to 2030
body: The Coca-Cola system announced a system-wide $10 billion U.S. infrastructure investment from 2026 through 2030 covering new or expanded production, distribution and office facilities.

context.text: Coca-Cola to spend $10B on US manufacturing by 2030
why: A $10B system-wide U.S. infrastructure commitment through 2030 signals major long-term capital deployment and capacity expansion.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola names Rob Gehring North America president
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on Sept. 25, 2026 that Rob Gehring will become president of its North America operating unit effective Dec. 1, 2026, succeeding interim lead John Murphy.

context.text: The Coca-Cola Company Names Rob Gehring President of North America Operating Unit
why: Permanent replacement of the North America president ends interim leadership and sets the region's strategic direction.
date evidence (day)
